title: Sandbagging
warm:
Brooks confronted [player_name] about sandbagging in the lobby circle where soft answers usually survived on marble and money. Homicide interest rising—said without saying, audible in the detective's refusal to accept traveling as liturgy. Vivienne's fate still contested: no settled body, four doors open, cadence weekly to monthly to gone underlined in a notebook that looked hungrier than missing-persons stationery.

"You tipped the concierge," Brooks said flatly. "You slowed my slate access. Soft neighbor tactics. In a file tilting colder, soft becomes complicit faster than it becomes charming."

[player_name]—early thirties, across the hall, soft alibi wearing daylight poorly—felt Nolan Greer at the edge of the circle and Marcus Pell farther back like a spare exit. Elevator chime. Wind sheer. Rhea's desk carefully blank. Unused perfume upstairs. Black car curb-idle as punctuation.

"I did not invent a corpse for you," [player_name] said. "I also did not gift you every night I saw. Sandbagging is an ugly word for partial survival. Vivienne may have left, been paid, died, or staged. I will not let your hunger close a door with my mouth as hinge."

Brooks almost smiled—not kind. "Then shield your billionaire from my politics and own the soft shield in public—or walk out of this circle and make him chase both the silence and you. Walking looks like innocence to cameras. It looks like flight to me."

Nolan's cufflinks clicked. Choice as consequence verbs: shield or walk. Soft alibi shrinking to a posture under lobby light.

She catalogued what Crownspire still offered as soft machinery: elevator chime late at night, wine glass ring on marble, Vivienne's unused perfume in a bath she should not know, black car idling at the curb, Brooks's badge flash in the lobby, Nolan's cufflinks clicking when he lied, Rhea's slate with thinning marks, wind sheer against floor-to-ceiling glass. Anchors rotated through the hour without stacking into elegant absolutes. Dialogue had already carried the subtext; the anchors only kept score. Hope and dread shared every doorway. Vivienne's willing leave, paid vanish, death, or staging remained L10-open on purpose—Layer 5 only allowed homicide interest to rise, never a settled corpse to end the wanting or the dread. [player_name] felt the soft alibi's remaining give and understood consequence would spend it either way.

Lobby circle sandbagging confrontation stripped soft of its wine-dark glamour. Daylight on badge. Daylight on neighbor. Daylight on a billionaire's cufflinks. Brooks named tactics [player_name] had used and made them sound like charges warming in a pocket. Walking looked like camera innocence and detective flight. Shielding looked like complicity wearing affection. Neither settled Vivienne; both spent the last of easy soft. Pell's distance said counsel preferred she shield. Nolan's click said he feared both verbs equally. [player_name] had to pick anyway.
hot:
Sandbagging under Brooks's eyes made [player_name]'s skin feel litigated and touched. Soft alibi daylight. Early thirties. Lobby circle. Homicide tilt without corpse. Nolan at the edge—rain-money heat she could not cross to without becoming exhibit. Mid-want inappropriate and undeniable.

Shield meant stepping into him in public as politics wearing desire. Walk meant leaving with her cunt still aching toward the man Brooks wanted her to sink. Both verbs tasted like his almost-kiss. She chose under badge flash and wind sheer, unfinished on purpose.

Body-POV kept the through-line physical: pulse at throat, heat low in the belly, silk clinging, mid-want ending before climax because the next verb still owned the night. Nolan Greer only—mid-forties, finance and tech holding, brutal charm, rain-money cologne—romance lock unbroken. Crime stayed plot; intimacy stayed intimacy-forward, never gore-porn, never eroticizing absence as kink. Brooks's colder paper could press her skin; Vivienne's contested fate could press her ribs; neither turned sex into violence cosplay. [player_name] ached around unanswered questions the way Crownspire ached around a wife who might still be anywhere. Choosing hurt. Hurting meant the choice was real. Soft alibi had a pulse; Layer 5 made her feel every beat.

Daylight want was crueler than penthouse want—harder to hide, easier for Brooks to misread as performance. Shielding meant public nearness that would soak her. Walking meant private ache with sidewalk wind under her dress. Soft alibi eroticism under homicide tilt stayed body-true and plot-bound. She exited mid-want because climax in a lobby circle would have been a different story's mistake.

choices.text: Walk out — make Nolan chase the silence and you
